verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing, metering and entitlements platform. A platform of this kind could plausibly offer user-configured background automations, so the axis applies, but the evidence documents no such feature. The nearest items are adjacent: multi-phase subscription schedules that auto-transition (a billing primitive, not a general automation builder), webhooks that a developer could use to trigger their own workflows, and usage alerts. None of these is an autonomous automation capability that users set up within the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
